Burst strength >500 N — designed to provide strength for large defects and higher BMIs.
features: Tri-layer hybrid design: GORE 3D PGA:TMC Web Scaffold + Macroporous PTFE knit + Non-porous PGA:TMC film

PTFE knit — latest generation macroporous fibre designed for permanent strength
PTFE knit had least bacterial adherence vs competitive polypropylene knits (S. aureus study)

Non-porous PGA:TMC film minimises visceral attachment — no adhesion complications at 12 months clinically
Minimal contraction: -5.1% at 31 days, -6.6% at 180 days (animal studies)
Flexible and conformable — material memory for easy unrolling and optimal placement
No pre-soaking needed (may be dipped in sterile saline to facilitate handling)
MRI and CT compatible — PTFE visible in high-resolution imaging
100% synthetic — no human, animal or tissue-derived materials

about.supportingText: We partner closely with globally respected healthcare manufacturers to coordinate supply across operating rooms, surgical specialties, and acute-care departments.
about.hospitalCommitment: Our focus rests on responsive institutional service, transparent communication, and dependable coordination so hospital procurement teams and clinicians can focus on patient care.
about.vision: To serve as a trusted partner for hospitals and healthcare providers by making advanced surgical and clinical care technologies consistently accessible.
about.mission: To represent respected healthcare manufacturers with integrity, deliver attentive service to medical professionals, and uphold Care, Trust, and Innovation in every interaction.
